streamer-change-design.purpose: Decision-complete framing for material ownership and boundary changes.
streamer-change-design.evidence: The former architecture and feature-framing skills overlapped on broad refactors.
streamer-change-design.removalCriteria: Remove when durable design rules move to an enforced architecture tool with equivalent decision records.

streamer-contract-change.purpose: Compatibility-safe evolution of shared and persisted contracts.
streamer-contract-change.evidence: Capable generic agents miss old consumers, absent values, and persisted compatibility cases.
streamer-contract-change.removalCriteria: Remove when repository tooling can discover every producer, consumer, and migration obligation automatically.

streamer-delivery.purpose: Authorization-aware Git, PR, CI, handoff, and release preparation.
streamer-delivery.evidence: Delivery actions have external-state boundaries that verification alone does not express.
streamer-delivery.removalCriteria: Remove when the delivery platform enforces authorization and evidence binding without agent instructions.

streamer-dependency-change.purpose: Safe npm, native, provenance, audit, and lockfile changes.
streamer-dependency-change.evidence: Streamer has pinned runtime, native compatibility, patch, and install-script constraints.
streamer-dependency-change.removalCriteria: Remove when dependency automation enforces the complete runtime and native matrix.

streamer-incident-response.purpose: Privacy-safe containment and root-cause work for production and release-candidate incidents.
streamer-incident-response.evidence: Incident, performance, and telemetry workflows previously activated independently for one investigation.
streamer-incident-response.removalCriteria: Remove when incident tooling supplies equivalent severity, evidence, containment, and recovery gates.

streamer-reliability-change.purpose: Bounded failure and recovery semantics across independently failing boundaries.
streamer-reliability-change.evidence: Generic implementations often omit retry ownership, cancellation, degraded states, and sensitive-data limits.
streamer-reliability-change.removalCriteria: Remove when boundary contracts mechanically enforce timeout, retry, cancellation, recovery, and telemetry policy.

streamer-security-boundaries.purpose: Trust-boundary review for untrusted data, privileges, IPC, files, networking, and sensitive state.
streamer-security-boundaries.evidence: Streamer handles add-on URLs, native bridges, media identifiers, and constrained telemetry.
streamer-security-boundaries.removalCriteria: Remove only when automated policy covers all listed trust boundaries and privacy constraints.

streamer-ui-change.purpose: Adaptive and accessible Expo and Electron UI changes using shared tokens.
streamer-ui-change.evidence: Streamer requires phone and desktop behavior and visual evidence beyond generic component implementation.
streamer-ui-change.removalCriteria: Remove when the shared design system and visual gates fully encode adaptive and accessibility expectations.

streamer-verification.purpose: Changed-file verification plans and receipts bound to final content.
streamer-verification.evidence: Completion claims previously depended on manually selected and sometimes stale checks.
streamer-verification.removalCriteria: Remove when CI and local tooling automatically select all focused checks and bind results to exact task files.
